title: equisetum fluviatile var. polystachium
intro: Equisetum fluviatile var. polystachium, commonly known as river horsetail, is a type of plant that belongs to the Equisetaceae family, a group of vascular plants that are known for their unique, hollow stems. River horsetail has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of kidney and urinary tract issues, due to its diuretic and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of river horsetail include its ability to stimulate urine production, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant activity, making it a potential remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of river horsetail include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to confirm its efficacy and safety.
